test_cases.description: Each component retrieved from pageComponentMap renders the h1 heading that matches its key, ensuring the map wires the correct component to each key rather than having swapped or mismatched entries
The barrel index module re-exports all 13 named page components so consumers can import them individually without going through the map
The barrel index module exports pageComponentMap as a named export so consumers can import the map directly
assertions: pageComponentMap is a named export from the barrel

test_cases.description: The heading element is specifically an h1 tag, not an h2/h3/span styled to look like a heading — the contract requires an h1 element
The pipeline diagram img alt attribute is the exact string specified in the contract, not a substring or close variant
assertions: img alt is exactly 'exemplar.tools pipeline diagram'
There is exactly one img with that alt text

test_cases.description: The pipeline diagram img src attribute is a non-empty string value (from the Vite SVG import), not undefined or empty
assertions: img src is a non-empty string
img src is not the literal string 'undefined'

test_cases.description: Each page component renders exactly one h1 element — proper document structure requires a single primary heading per page
assertions: Each of the 13 page components has exactly one h1 in its rendered output

test_cases.description: Page components are substantive documentation pages with content beyond just a heading — they should render multiple elements, not just a bare h1
assertions: Rendered innerHTML length is significantly more than just a heading
Multiple child elements exist in the rendered output

test_cases.description: The pageComponentMap contains no keys beyond the 13 specified PageComponentKey values — no accidental extra entries
assertions: No keys exist that are not in the PageComponentKey enum

test_cases.description: The pageComponentMap keys are the exact lowercase enum string values, not PascalCase component names or any other casing variant
assertions: No key starts with uppercase letter

test_cases.description: Every page module (not just HomePage) has both a named and default export that are referentially identical — the visible test only checks HomePage
Page components are zero-argument functional components that render correctly when called with no props — they must not require any props to function
assertions: Components render without error when given empty props object
Components render without error when given no props

test_cases.description: When rendering components obtained by iterating over pageComponentMap entries, each renders an h1 with text matching its key's expected heading — prevents hardcoded map with dummy components
assertions: All 13 map entries render an h1 when mounted
The h1 text varies per component (not all the same)

test_cases.description: HomePage is a full overview page with content beyond just the heading and pipeline diagram — it should contain explanatory text about the CLI suite
assertions: Rendered output contains text content beyond just the heading
